title: Co-moving volumes and Reynolds transport theorem in DiPerna-Lions theory
summary: Co-moving volumes and Reynolds transport theorem along a fluid flow are fundamental tools to derive balance laws in fluid mechanics, where the classical theory on flow maps of ODEs associated to smooth vector fields plays a central role. Related to weak solutions of Navier-Stokes equations in Sobolev classes, DiPerna-Lions (Invent. Math. 1989) generalized the classical notion of ODEs and flow maps in the case of vector fields belonging to Sobolev classes.
